description: This file contains a selector function 'canAccessChannelSettings' that determines user permissions for accessing various tabs in the channel settings modal within a Mattermost web application. It checks permissions for Info, Configuration, Archive, and auto-translation features based on channel type and user permissions.

methods.name: canAccessChannelSettings
methods.description: A selector function that evaluates if a user has access to any tab in the channel settings modal based on permissions and channel type.
